name: access_profiles
description: Company-customized access profile: a named set of delegable business capabilities that grants can carry instead of a standard role.
lifecycle: Created ACTIVE; edited with expected versions, so every holder's access follows the current capabilities; archived rather than deleted, and only when no effective grant holds it.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated immutable profile UUID; public resource ID.
Profile name, unique among the company's active profiles regardless of case.

Delegable capability names (branches.view, invitations.manage, audit.view, devices.view, devices.manage, media.view, media.upload, media.archive, programming.view, programming.edit, programming.assign, publications.publish, catalogs.view, catalogs.edit, catalogs.manage, prices.edit); company administration is never delegable through a profile.
ACTIVE profiles can be granted; ARCHIVED profiles are retained for attribution.
Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful change.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change; not audit history.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A profile belongs to an existing company.
A profile names at least one capability, all of them delegable.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_profiles_company_active_name_unique ON public.access_profiles USING btree (company_id, lower((name)::text)) WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE'::"AccessProfileStatus")
constraints.Purpose: Active profile names are unique within a company, ignoring case.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_profiles_company_id_id_key ON public.access_profiles USING btree (company_id, id)
